releaseNotes:
fix(assembly): finalize sends only PCMs; coded 400 texts (BBL-242)

The finalize PATCH body is now exactly { pcms }. startDate is stamped by
the server when preconfigure creates the config, and logistic #148
refuses any startDate / endDate key on the PATCH with 400
CONFIG_WINDOW_NOT_EDITABLE. GatewayErrors.toAppError passes a coded 400
through as the server's text (uncoded 400s stay HTTP 400), so an older
build meeting the new server reads why finalize failed.

Tests: wire test (real Retrofit + production Json) pins the PATCH body to
the single pcms key; coded/uncoded 400 mapping; finalize 400 text.
